{{Quote|Looks like you're headed to the ocean dunes of Karnac.|Greef Karga, to Din Djarin|<ref name="Chapter 3" />}}
'''Karnac''' was a terrestrial<ref name="Chapter 3" /> celestial body<ref name="DoR">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> located in the [[Karnac system]] of the [[Cadma sector]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[the Slice]]<ref name="Slice" /> in grid square T-8 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> Its surface featured [[ocean]] dunes.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|3}}</ref> a [[Unidentified Mon Calamari nobleman|nobleman's]] [[Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari nobleman's son|son]] skipped bail and went into hiding on the ocean dunes of Karnac, with a [[bounty]] being posted on them. That [[Standard year|year]], the [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] accepted a bounty [[holopuck]] for the [[noble]]man's [[Gender|son]] from [[Greef Karga]],<ref name="Chapter 3" /> the [[Guild Master]]<ref name="Chapter 21">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}}</ref> of the [[Nevarro Hunters|Bounty Hunters Guild]] of<ref name="Highlights">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-21-the-pirate-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 21: The Pirate"}}</ref> the [[Dalicron sector]] [[planet]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Nevarro]],<ref name="Highlights" /> who noted that Djarin would be heading to Karnac. Djarin, however, ultimately chose to instead attempt to [[Incident on Nevarro|rescue]] the [[youngling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], whom he had previously turned in to an [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial faction]] in exchange for a bounty.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karnac was introduced via a mention of the "ocean dunes of Karnac" in "[[Chapter 3: The Sin]],"<ref name="Chapter 3" /> the third episode of the [[Disney+]] television show ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]]. The episode aired on [[November 22]], [[2019]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|201|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season One Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One Companion}}</ref> The [[2023]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]] subsequently identified Karnac as a distinct celestial body. That book also placed Karnac in what corresponds to<ref name="DoR" /> the "U" column of the Standard Galactic Grid,<ref name="GalaxyMap">[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]</ref> but the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' went on to explicitly place it in grid square T-8 instead.<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref>
